review:
A proper old-school 100-line fruit machine with lucky charms. There are two scatters: horseshoes pay anywhere, and three diamonds on reels 1, 3 and 4 pay a separate win.

The wild can expand to fill its whole reel and hit several lines at once, and after any base-game win you can gamble it on a card colour or suit. Here's the surprise: despite the classic look, it's rated very high volatility, with a 3,000x cap and a strong 97% RTP. Good if you like lots of lines and traditional symbols, but don't expect it to play gently.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
